decisionBoundary: Source artifact describing the consumer entry and shell replacement contract. It is not an executable policy, installed runtime profile, authorization, host qualification or release receipt.

qualificationScope.sourceCompileGuard: C source allows Apple arm64/aarch64 or x86_64; that compile guard does not widen the frozen qualification scope.

identity.gid: existing GID and getgid() == getegid(); no numeric GID is pinned

ordered.format: same lexical absolute path rules; this check alone does not establish physical path identity

orderedEnvp.valueFrom: physical passwd home for current UID; getpwuid_r UID/GID must match and realpath must equal pw_dir

stdioAndFds.processReplacement: POSIX_SPAWN_SETEXEC; successful spawn replaces the supervisor image and creates no persistent child

signals.childSignalDispositions: default for all signals except SIGKILL and SIGSTOP, whose dispositions cannot be changed

compileTimePins.purpose: exact approved fixed launcher bytes SHA-256
independently approved requirement constraining signer and identifier

externalPrerequisites: An independently reviewed protected installer and external installation receipt must establish native image provenance, final signed-image SHA-256/CDHashes, signer/identifier, flags, entitlements, load commands/dependencies, and actual host protection.
macOS/OS-enforced pre-main protection of the native image is required. The source's Security checks and environment clearing run after main and cannot establish pre-main trust.

The fixed install namespace and every ancestor/leaf must be root-owned, non-symlinked, ACL-free, not group/other writable, and free of special permission bits; regular protected files must have one link. Unreadable or unsupported ACL state is HOLD.

The fixed native image, bootstrap manifest, launcher, and /bin/sh must match the source bounds and protected-file checks; manifest and launcher hashes must match independently approved compile-time pins.

Only fixed Apple system-library/framework dependencies are allowed; no candidate or user-writable load command, @rpath, @loader_path, or @executable_path dependency. Actual hardened-runtime/preloader behavior on the frozen host still requires independent evidence.

The separately protected target policy at fixedProtectedPaths.targetPolicy must be independently owner-authorized and installed before qualification. This contract supplies no repository, target ID, owner grant, revision, run, policy values or expiry.
Installer changes must be serialized against active invocations. Root/kernel compromise and concurrent privileged replacement remain outside this unprivileged threat contract.

currentDownstreamAlignment.launcher: requires zero script arguments and receives the same nine-key environment; validates the fixed installation, manifest, Node, launcher, and gate before invoking Node
currentDownstreamAlignment.gateBoundary: requires fixed Node and gate paths, process.argv length 2, no process.execArgv, the nine-key allowlist, and rejects NODE_OPTIONS, NODE_PATH, DYLD_*, and LD_*
currentDownstreamAlignment.alignment: shell -> installed Node -> gate arguments/environment are source-compatible with the proposed shell replacement

mismatchesAndLimitations.issue: The native supervisor validates exact argv[0..10], but cannot establish the incoming executable startup environment before main. Empty incoming envp and actual OS pre-main protection require separate caller and installation evidence.

The C compile guard permits x86_64, while selected qualification scope remains ARM64 and the current installed target reader rejects x64. Compilation eligibility does not establish host qualification.

The non-ad-hoc profile and four static signature flags are conservative selected build conditions. They are not proven to be the unique necessary profile; no signer, approved signing requirement, authorization or capability is supplied.
Source integration does not establish protected installation, external OS pre-main enforcement, a trusted self-receipt or release acceptance. Signature checks and environ clearing occur after main.
Runtime input path syntax is checked lexically by the supervisor. It does not establish physical source/artifact/state identity or replace downstream path, source and policy validators.
